update_rule: New verified defects must be recorded on a PR to main with evidence, diagnosis, regression test status and owner; never erase an OPEN error without exact-run evidence.

records.diagnosis: Existing MCP get_market_bars accepts 1m/5m/15m/1h, not 1d. Historical D1 repair exists in open PR #749, not deployed.
records.mandatory_action: Do not call vendor OpenD D1-broken; fix cloud MCP consumer 1d contract and verify exact deployed SHA.

records.diagnosis: US cloud closed-bar finality proof absent; a bar is_closed field in historical snapshot does not independently establish provider finality.
records.mandatory_action: Preserve all Radar trade admission BLOCKED; collect provider callback and finality during actual RTH.

records.diagnosis: QQQ/NVDA/GLDM aggregate VWAP sometimes outside same-bar OHLC. Suspected turnover/volume aggregation mismatch; source semantics not verified.
records.mandatory_action: Quarantine derived VWAP; inspect provider amount units, fix aggregator and exact-head regression before claiming clean.

records.diagnosis: Cross-read source sequence can drift while producer and consumer publish; permanent mismatch not proven.
records.mandatory_action: Atomic capture/recheck source revision+runtime+sequence, do not equate health heartbeat with aligned Radar analysis.

records.diagnosis: GitHub Actions 15m XNYS cron code merged in #931; actual scheduled execution and Discord receipt have not been verified.
records.mandatory_action: Require distinct proof for cron trigger, SSM success, new bars, analysis, Discord HTTP acceptance and client receipt.

records.diagnosis: Cloud 60m normalization row count below required threshold; #927 handles valid 1-3 intraday bars but is not deployed.
records.mandatory_action: Differentiate legitimate partial 60m day vs invalid daily depth; rerun after exact patch/environment change only.

records.diagnosis: Gold ETF observation MCP had Tencent fallback; source provider was not TickFlow despite status PASS.
records.mandatory_action: Reject any provider other than TickFlow for A-share validation; do not call fallback PASS.

records.diagnosis: Cloud minute endpoints had incorrect route; intraday resolutions require TickFlow intraday endpoint rather than D1 getter.
records.mandatory_action: Use provider official endpoint by resolution and verify Windows NativeSDK five periods first.

records.diagnosis: GitHub success denotes code/test transport, not qualified live data, bar finality, provider ownership, notification or trade readiness.
records.mandatory_action: Report CI, deployment, source qualification, Radar signal admission, and notification as separate gates.

records.diagnosis: GitHub main vs deployed EC2 version can diverge; same-source worker heartbeats alone do not prove current main was deployed.
records.mandatory_action: Verify expected immutable main, deployed LiveFeed/Radar/MCP SHA and canonical snapshot provenance independently.

records.diagnosis: Repeated commands against identical failing revision/environment produced no new engineering evidence.
records.mandatory_action: STOP duplicate retry; require distinct root-cause hypothesis, code change, environment correction or targeted evidence.

records.diagnosis: Livefeed HEALTHY heartbeat and LV3 rights do not establish current trading-session market K-line delivery.
records.mandatory_action: Measure last provider bar and push callback, compare against US session time; guard weekend/premarket separately.

records.diagnosis: The first self-improvement ai-governance run rejected valid TickFlow symbols and endpoint signatures because its token schema forbade '.'; the initial backend-gate failed as a consequence.
records.mandatory_action: Keep dotted official symbols/endpoints valid and run the real ai-governance script plus focused regression on exact PR head before claiming registry compliance.

records.diagnosis: Actual PR #934 exact-head backend CI job 2/3 failed three engineering-autonomy loop cases: newly added unknown-incident recorder incorrectly validated SHA256 queue fingerprint with a 40-hex Git commit SHA validator. A queue fingerprint is 64 hex digits; commit SHA stays 40.
records.mandatory_action: Use independent exact validators for the 64-character queue SHA256 and 40-character Git commit SHA, run loop fail-fast test and incident receipt regression at the same PR head; do not simply retry unchanged CI.

records.diagnosis: The main-branch Engineering Autonomy 120m workflow installed only pytest, but its fixed queue commands invoked pytest with tests/conftest.py enabled. The global application conftest imports anyio/FastAPI/httpx and failed before the reviewed autonomy tests ran. The failure was captured on run 39439612414 at main SHA 7e1ca0edc7be2c099bf3638ead49f994a2cefde1.
records.mandatory_action: Keep the reviewed pytest commands aligned with the existing secretless coding-pilot command by adding --noconftest; require exact-head CI and a fresh main workflow run to reach PASS before marking mitigated. Never resume the failed queue after its fingerprint changes.
